title: Not meant to hold anything heavy without additional bracing
text: Not meant to hold anything heavy without additional bracing. I intended to use this cabinet as overhead storage for cups and bowls in a weekend cabin. However, the included pressed board hanger is way too flimsy. It might be fine for a short term install that won't involve any real weight being put inside. Instead, we ended up having to build a brace out of real wood and attaching it to wall studs. The cabinet itself looks nice, but I seriously doubt it will last more than a year or two before it begins to come apart.

description: The Legacy Storage Collection offers it all from combo files and bookcases to stackable storage and laterals. This 36-inch wall-mounted storage cabinet helps maximize storage space without sacrificing surface area. Two low-profile sliding doors open to a spacious interior that can store binders, paperwork or personal items. Both doors lock and have black handles. It mounts to the wall using a sturdy French cleat and can be hung at any height. Finished in an attractive Cherry laminate, storage components coordinate with other Legacy furniture which makes customizing easy. The Legacy collection is constructed of a 1-inch thick thermal fused melamine laminate with a 3-millimeter commercial grade matching PVC edge. Laminates are scratch, stain and scald resistant. Legacy casegoods are backed by a 10-year limited manufacturer's warranty. Please allow an extended lead time.
